name: rpa-gen-rules
description: Create or refresh agent project rules (Cursor .cursor/rules/*.mdc, Claude Code CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules). Layered-cake architecture + BDD-style delivery, with a mandatory Rules Sync step that mirrors changes across every agent's rule tree. Generated rules and AGENTS.md are written in English unless the user asks for another language.

interface.shortDescription: Generate Cursor/Claude agent rules: layered-cake + BDD, with Rules Sync.
